report.summary: Recognizable, charming animal-hospital miniature: the low broad form, muted hipped roof, tan masonry, pale entrance surround, navy sign, blue canopy, and dark glazing capture the key identity. The single principal portal is coherent and no obvious broken geometry is visible.

orientation.summary: The labeled +u render contains the sole principal double door, matching the actual door inventory on +u (SW outward bearing 215°). Located SV1 sits southwest and looks NE directly toward +u, where the real signed entrance is visible; located SV3 provides an oblique +u/-v view that also shows the entrance. The other three rendered faces contain no competing principal portal.

issues.problem: The oversized, deep central hip makes the roof visually heavier and more pyramidal than the reference building’s shallower, low-slung silhouette.
issues.fix: Lower the main ridge and soften the roof pitch while retaining the broad hipped profile.

issues.problem: The side and rear elevations are very plain compared with the front, reducing the model’s all-around miniature charm.
issues.fix: Add restrained window or service-detail rhythm to the secondary faces without creating another entrance.
